changelog: - **The marketing account import carries `external_id` and the funnel-record dates** (#2554, story #2391). Four new columns, each with DE/TR aliases: `external_id` → `Company.externalId` (for SaleVali the merchant's `User._id`, the key #2565 proposes — until now nothing filled the column the usage feed matches on), and `trial_started_at` / `trial_ends_at` / `customer_since` → the funnel record's `trialStartedAt` / `trialEndsAt` / `startDate`, so an imported trial is reminded about and expires like any other and the cohort/aging reports read when the customer arrived instead of the import day. Dates are ISO only (`YYYY-MM-DD`, or a date-time with a zone); `04.05.2026`, a zoneless time, an impossible date and an end before the start are row ERRORs. The match order is now `externalId > VAT > name+country`, and the external id can only confirm the weaker keys: an id two accounts already carry, an id and a VAT naming two accounts, a match that carries a different id, or one id given to two accounts in one file is an ERROR on that row (dry run included) — never a guess. The engine's plan vocabulary has no ERROR, so the diff plans such a row as a SKIP carrying `refused` and `applyPlannedAccounts` reports it as ERROR. Writes go through `planFieldUpdates`: a new record takes every date, an existing one only has gaps filled unless `--authoritative`, and the reason names what was left alone (`funnelRecord.trialEndsAt`). The #2551 default window still applies to a `TRIAL_ACTIVE` row without `trial_ends_at`, but a file date always wins over the stamp (`trialWindowFor` is asked with the file's dates as the existing window, so a file `trial_started_at` alone gets its end counted from itself), and the dry run warns on the row; a record already in `TRIAL_ACTIVE` with no end is warned about too. No schema change (`Company.externalId` exists since #2446); `TEXT_LIMITS.companyExternalId` (191) added. Tests: 12 new cases in `scripts/test/marketing-import.test.mjs`, whose in-memory writer now builds relations with the production `funnelRelationCreateData`/`UpdateData`, including an imported trial appearing in `selectDueTrialReminders`; the sample fixture gains the four columns and two trial rows and is run twice by a test.
